summary: Update owned tracing dependencies for the upstream diagnostic-logging fix
details: Pin the owned OpenTelemetry SDK and OTLP base exporter to v1.45.0 for GO-2026-6505 while retaining the explicit diagnostic and export restrictions.
Resolve nine reviewed application module version changes without introducing module paths or changing the supported Go minimum.
Add a regression showing that upstream diagnostic representations omit client and exporter instance fields.

compatibility.notes: Public Evydence SDK wrappers and persistence formats are unchanged. Changed modules require Go 1.25.0, below the existing Go 1.26.10 minimum.

security: Use the upstream-fixed modules rather than relying on the application logging policy to satisfy vulnerability analysis. Existing attribute, resource, baggage and transport restrictions remain in place.
limitations: Other dependency observations retain their own advisory and admission scope.
Unchanged upstream license bytes do not automatically admit a new exact dependency version.
